poke_normal_pound.strategy: Basic neutral damage with no drawbacks.
poke_normal_pound.combos: Use after War Posture for boosted damage.
poke_normal_pound.competitiveTip: Outclassed by stronger moves, but reliable early game.

poke_normal_quick-attack.strategy: Priority move that always goes first. Great for finishing low HP opponents.
poke_normal_quick-attack.combos: Perfect after setting up Attack boosts.
poke_normal_quick-attack.counters: Low power means it won't break bulky defenders.
poke_normal_quick-attack.competitiveTip: Essential for revenge killing and bypassing speed disadvantage.

poke_normal_swords-dance.strategy: Sharply raises Attack (+2 stages). One of the best setup moves in the game.
poke_normal_swords-dance.combos: Follow with strong physical attacks for devastating sweeps.
poke_normal_swords-dance.counters: Status moves like paralysis or confusion disrupt setup.
poke_normal_swords-dance.competitiveTip: The premier physical setup move. One boost often enough to sweep.

poke_normal_double-edge.strategy: Massive neutral damage but hurts you too. High risk, high reward.
poke_normal_double-edge.combos: Use when you're about to faint anyway for maximum value.
poke_normal_double-edge.counters: Recoil damage adds up quickly. Ghost types immune.
poke_normal_double-edge.competitiveTip: Best saved for late-game when recoil won't matter.

poke_normal_recover.strategy: Heals 50% of max HP. Essential for sustain strategies.
poke_normal_recover.combos: Use behind defensive boosts for maximum longevity.
poke_normal_recover.counters: High damage attackers can out-pace healing.
poke_normal_recover.competitiveTip: Core move for stall and balanced teams.

poke_fire_flare-blitz.strategy: The strongest physical Fire move. Recoil is painful but damage is immense.
poke_fire_flare-blitz.combos: Best on high HP attackers who can absorb recoil.
poke_fire_flare-blitz.counters: Water, Earth, and Stone types resist and hit back hard.
poke_fire_flare-blitz.competitiveTip: Signature move for physical Fire sweepers.

poke_fire_flamethrower.strategy: Reliable special Fire STAB with burn chance. The go-to Fire move.
poke_fire_flamethrower.combos: Burns cripple physical attackers, reducing their damage by 50%.
poke_fire_flamethrower.counters: Flash Fire absorbers turn this into a boost for them.
poke_fire_flamethrower.competitiveTip: Standard special Fire option. Consistent and powerful.

poke_fire_will-o-wisp.strategy: Guaranteed burn on hit. Cripples physical attackers completely.
poke_fire_will-o-wisp.combos: Use against physical threats to halve their Attack.
poke_fire_will-o-wisp.counters: Fire types and those immune to burn are unaffected.
poke_fire_will-o-wisp.competitiveTip: Essential utility for defensive Fire types.

poke_fire_overheat.strategy: Nuclear option - massive damage but drops your Special Attack by 2 stages.
poke_fire_overheat.combos: Use as a nuke then switch out to reset stats.
poke_fire_overheat.counters: Can only use once effectively before needing to switch.

poke_fire_lava-plume.strategy: Strong Fire move with 30% burn chance. Balanced power and utility.
poke_fire_lava-plume.combos: High burn rate makes it excellent against physical teams.
poke_fire_lava-plume.counters: Slightly weaker than Flamethrower but more likely to burn.
poke_fire_lava-plume.competitiveTip: Preferred on defensive Fire types for status spreading.

poke_water_wave-crash.strategy: Strongest physical Water move. Pure power for aggressive Water types.
poke_water_wave-crash.combos: Rain boosts Water moves even further.
poke_water_wave-crash.counters: Grass and Dragon types resist. High cost move.
poke_water_wave-crash.competitiveTip: Go-to physical Water STAB for offensive builds.

poke_water_aqua-jet.strategy: Priority Water move. Essential for picking off weakened foes.
poke_water_aqua-jet.combos: After Swords Dance, becomes a dangerous priority threat.
poke_water_aqua-jet.counters: Low base power limits effectiveness against healthy targets.
poke_water_aqua-jet.competitiveTip: Revenge killing tool for Water sweepers.

poke_water_crabhammer.strategy: High crit rate Water physical. Risk vs reward gameplay.
poke_water_crabhammer.combos: Critical hits ignore the opponent's Defense boosts.
poke_water_crabhammer.counters: 90% accuracy means occasional misses at crucial moments.
poke_water_crabhammer.competitiveTip: Signature Lobster move. Thematic and powerful.

poke_water_waterfall.strategy: Reliable physical Water with flinch chance. Solid all-around option.
poke_water_waterfall.combos: Flinch chance pairs well with speed advantage.
poke_water_waterfall.counters: Grass and Dragon resistances limit coverage.
poke_water_waterfall.competitiveTip: Standard physical Water STAB with utility.

poke_electric_volt-tackle.strategy: Maximum Electric physical damage with heavy recoil. Glass cannon move.
poke_electric_volt-tackle.combos: Paralysis from other moves helps ensure you move first.
poke_electric_volt-tackle.counters: Recoil damage adds up. Earth types immune.
poke_electric_volt-tackle.competitiveTip: High risk, high reward. Best for fast, frail attackers.

poke_electric_zippy-zap.strategy: Priority Electric move with high power. Extremely dangerous.
poke_electric_zippy-zap.combos: Always goes first AND always crits - devastating combo.
poke_electric_zippy-zap.counters: Earth immunity shuts it down completely.
poke_electric_zippy-zap.competitiveTip: One of the best priority moves in the game.

poke_electric_thunder-wave.strategy: Guaranteed paralysis on hit. Speed control for your whole team.
poke_electric_thunder-wave.combos: Paralyze fast threats, then outspeed with your sweepers.
poke_electric_thunder-wave.counters: Ground types immune. Electric types resist paralysis.
poke_electric_thunder-wave.competitiveTip: Core support move. Changes speed dynamics of battles.

poke_grass_solar-blade.strategy: Powerful physical Grass STAB. Two-turn charging limits utility.
poke_grass_solar-blade.counters: Charging turn allows opponent to switch or set up.
poke_grass_solar-blade.competitiveTip: Best in sun teams. Risky otherwise.

poke_grass_mega-drain.strategy: Drains HP equal to half damage dealt. Sustain in a box.
poke_grass_mega-drain.combos: Stacks well with recovery items and abilities.
poke_grass_mega-drain.counters: Low base power limits damage output.
poke_grass_mega-drain.competitiveTip: Survival tool for Grass types. Outlast opponents.

poke_grass_spiky-shield.strategy: Priority protection that damages attackers on contact.
poke_grass_spiky-shield.combos: Scout opponent's moves while dealing chip damage.
poke_grass_spiky-shield.counters: Non-contact moves bypass the damage effect.
poke_grass_spiky-shield.competitiveTip: Excellent for mind games and stalling.

poke_grass_stun-spore.strategy: Spreads paralysis to slow down threats. Accuracy is shaky.
poke_grass_stun-spore.combos: Paralyze faster opponents to give your team speed advantage.
poke_grass_stun-spore.counters: 75% accuracy means it can miss at bad times.
poke_grass_stun-spore.competitiveTip: Speed control option for Grass types.

poke_ice_freeze-dry.strategy: Super effective against Water types despite being Ice. Unique coverage.
poke_ice_freeze-dry.counters: Lower power than other Ice options.
poke_ice_freeze-dry.competitiveTip: Invaluable for hitting Water types that usually resist Ice.

poke_ice_ice-beam.strategy: Reliable special Ice STAB with freeze chance. Standard Ice option.
poke_ice_ice-beam.counters: Water, Ice, Fire, and Metal resist.
poke_ice_ice-beam.competitiveTip: Go-to Ice move for special attackers.

poke_martial_close-combat.strategy: Maximum Fighting damage but drops your defenses. Glass cannon move.
poke_martial_close-combat.combos: Use after setup or when you're about to faint anyway.
poke_martial_close-combat.counters: Defense drops leave you vulnerable to priority.
poke_martial_close-combat.competitiveTip: Premier Fighting STAB. The best offensive option.

poke_martial_mach-punch.strategy: Priority Fighting move. Revenge killing tool.
poke_martial_mach-punch.combos: After Iron Fist boost or Attack boosts, becomes deadly.
poke_martial_mach-punch.counters: Low power struggles against bulky targets.
poke_martial_mach-punch.competitiveTip: Essential for picking off weakened threats.

poke_venom_toxic.strategy: Inflicts badly poisoned status. Damage doubles each turn.
poke_venom_toxic.combos: Stall with protection moves while poison damage stacks.
poke_venom_toxic.counters: Metal types immune. Venom types can't be poisoned.
poke_venom_toxic.competitiveTip: Core move for stall strategies. Wears down walls.

poke_venom_sludge-bomb.strategy: Strong special Poison STAB with 30% poison chance.
poke_venom_sludge-bomb.counters: Metal immunity blocks all Poison damage.
poke_venom_sludge-bomb.competitiveTip: Primary Venom STAB for special attackers.

poke_earth_earthquake.strategy: The definitive Ground move. High power, perfect accuracy, hits 5 types super effectively.
poke_earth_earthquake.combos: Pair with Air partners who are immune to it.
poke_earth_earthquake.competitiveTip: One of the best moves in the game. Essential coverage.

poke_air_hurricane.strategy: Strong Air STAB with confusion chance. Devastating in rain.
poke_air_hurricane.competitiveTip: Best on rain teams. Risk vs reward otherwise.

poke_air_brave-bird.strategy: Maximum Air physical power with recoil. The Flying equivalent of Flare Blitz.

poke_psyche_psychic.strategy: Standard Psyche STAB with Special Defense drop chance.
poke_psyche_psychic.combos: SpDef drops help special attackers break through.
poke_psyche_psychic.counters: Shadow types are immune. Metal resists.
poke_psyche_psychic.competitiveTip: Reliable Psyche option for special attackers.

poke_psyche_calm-mind.strategy: Boosts Special Attack AND Special Defense. Fantastic setup move.
poke_psyche_calm-mind.combos: Multiple boosts make you both stronger and bulkier.
poke_psyche_calm-mind.counters: Physical attackers bypass the SpDef boost.
poke_psyche_calm-mind.competitiveTip: Premier special setup move. Transforms battles.

poke_insect_u-turn.strategy: Deals damage then switches out. Maintains momentum.
poke_insect_u-turn.combos: Scout opponent's switch-in while dealing chip damage.

poke_stone_stone-edge.strategy: High power Stone STAB with boosted crit rate. Risk vs reward.

poke_stone_stealth-rock.strategy: Entry hazard that damages foes when they switch in. Chips away health.
poke_stone_stealth-rock.combos: Forces unfavorable switches and chip damage over time.
poke_stone_stealth-rock.counters: Rapid Spin or Defog clears hazards.
poke_stone_stealth-rock.competitiveTip: One of the most influential moves in competitive play.

poke_ghost_shadow-ball.strategy: Standard Ghost STAB with SpDef drop chance. Reliable and powerful.
poke_ghost_shadow-ball.combos: SpDef drops snowball into easy KOs.
poke_ghost_shadow-ball.competitiveTip: Go-to Ghost move for special attackers.

poke_ghost_shadow-sneak.strategy: Priority Ghost move. Picks off weakened foes.
poke_ghost_shadow-sneak.combos: After Swords Dance, becomes a priority nuke.
poke_ghost_shadow-sneak.counters: Low power limits effectiveness against healthy targets.

poke_dragon_outrage.strategy: Locked into this move for 2-3 turns but deals massive damage.
poke_dragon_outrage.combos: Best used late-game when counters are eliminated.
poke_dragon_outrage.counters: Mystic types are immune. Confusion after ends.
poke_dragon_outrage.competitiveTip: High risk, high reward. Clean up with it.

poke_dragon_dragon-dance.strategy: Boosts Attack AND Speed. The most dangerous setup move.
poke_dragon_dragon-dance.combos: One boost often enough to sweep entire teams.
poke_dragon_dragon-dance.counters: Priority moves, status, or Mystic types.

poke_shadow_knock-off.strategy: Deals damage and removes opponent's held item. Utility king.
poke_shadow_knock-off.counters: Already itemless opponents take reduced damage.
poke_shadow_knock-off.competitiveTip: One of the best utility moves. Always useful.

poke_shadow_sucker-punch.strategy: Priority but only works if opponent is attacking.
poke_shadow_sucker-punch.counters: Fails if opponent uses status or switches.

poke_metal_iron-head.strategy: Reliable Metal physical STAB with flinch chance.
poke_metal_iron-head.combos: Speed advantage makes flinch more likely.

poke_metal_flash-cannon.strategy: Standard special Metal STAB with SpDef drop chance.
poke_metal_flash-cannon.competitiveTip: Go-to Metal STAB for special attackers.

poke_mystic_moonblast.strategy: Strong Mystic STAB with SpAtk drop chance. Reliable and powerful.
poke_mystic_moonblast.competitiveTip: Premier Mystic STAB for special attackers.

poke_mystic_play-rough.strategy: Physical Mystic STAB with Attack drop chance.
poke_mystic_play-rough.combos: Hits Dragon, Shadow, and Martial super effectively.
